payload.prompt: Create an environmental portrait as a satirical scene of fictional Korean Marine barracks life, with a reference-guided central person and a military inspection turned absurd. Use the supplied image as appearance guidance for her face and short black bob. Her visible facial proportions, brown eyes, soft straight fringe and jaw-length dark hair carry into a fictional Marine woman. She stands at attention in ankle-deep clear water inside a worn barracks corridor, wearing a red Marine training T-shirt, khaki utility shorts and black boots. She holds a long mop upright with her left hand; its continuous handle leads down to the wet mop head resting beside her boots. Her right hand makes a crisp salute at her temple, elbow bent naturally. She looks toward a solemn senior Marine sitting behind a dry inspection table inside a black inflatable dinghy that is grounded across the corridor. The senior wears fatigues and a red beret, holds a clipboard and looks from the recruit toward the mop. A ruler lies neatly along the table edge. The absurdity comes from an impeccably formal inspection continuing while both corridor and boat have become an indoor shoreline. Open barracks doorways reveal aligned bunks and wall lockers. Window reflections break around her boots and the mop head, keeping their contact with the shallow water readable. A soft reflected window light gives the central woman's face an appealing, quietly composed presence; the heavy practical setting and her dignified seriousness carry the joke together. Photograph the full central figure from eye level in a three-quarter view with a 35mm lens, framing her, the complete hand-to-mop connection, the boat, the table and the senior together. Landscape frame, connected depth, natural skin texture, subdued olive walls, red clothing accents and gentle water reflections, staged editorial photography with convincing physical scale.
